description.narrative: Swedish Tax Agency (STA) will jointly with Georgian Revenue Service (GRS) work on a project proposal STA to support GRS
Swedish Tax Agency (STA) will jointly with Georgian Revenue Service (GRS) work on a project proposal STA to support GRS

The Swedish Tax Agency (STA) approached Sida with a request to support (Service Purchase Agreement) a fact-finding mission in order to outline possible cooperation areas where STA can contribute to strengthening the Georgian Revenue Service (GRS) with a focus on capacity building.
The objectives of the fact-finding missions are:
1) To establish contact with key staff and management at the GRS and other relevant stakeholders such as the Embassy of Sweden, EU, IMF, World Bank and other donors of importance for designing the possible future support, and 2) To collect information from the GRS and the tax system in Georgia as well as the context where the authority is operating. Elaborating a strategic analysis of the current situation and needs is also envisaged.
Based on the achievements of the fact-finding mission, the overall objective will be to identify areas of possible Swedish support and to prepare a draft project document, including potential areas, objectives and modalities of a future cooperation betwen the two agencies.

Based on the achievements of the fact-finding mission, the overall objective to identify areas of possible Swedish support and to prepare a draft project document, including potential areas, objectives and modalities of a future cooperation between the two agencies has been achieved. The joint, proposal developed by GRS and STA was submitted to Sida for starting authority to authority cooperation.
The submitted project proposal is build around four components that were singled out as prioritised ones to be addressed. Those components are as follows:
- Taxpayer Service
- Enterprise Risk Management
- Compliance Risk Management and
- Data management
The purpose of the project is to provide support to GRS in order for the authority to realise its long-term strategy as regards to simplifying the process of fulfilling taxpayer obligations, providing flexible and accessible services, improving voluntary compliance, becoming more flexible and result-oriented and increasing public confidence.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
